verse.verse_1: By the Sun and his (glorious) splendour;
verse.verse_2: By the Moon as she follows him;
verse.verse_3: By the Day as it shows up (the Sun's) glory;
verse.verse_4: By the Night as it conceals it;
verse.verse_5: By the Firmament and its (wonderful) structure;
verse.verse_6: By the Earth and its (wide) expanse:
verse.verse_7: By the Soul, and the proportion and order given to it;
verse.verse_8: And its enlightenment as to its wrong and its right;-
verse.verse_9: Truly he succeeds that purifies it,
verse.verse_10: And he fails that corrupts it!
verse.verse_11: The Thamud (people) rejected (their prophet) through their inordinate wrong-doing,
verse.verse_12: Behold, the most wicked man among them was deputed (for impiety).
verse.verse_13: But the Messenger of Allah said to them: "It is a She-camel of Allah! And (bar her not from) having her drink!"
verse.verse_14: Then they rejected him (as a false prophet), and they hamstrung her. So their Lord, on account of their crime, obliterated their traces and made them equal (in destruction, high and low)!
verse.verse_15: And for Him is no fear of its consequences.
